notes: Python and other script software can now take arguments, send the whole project folder and ask for GPUs; for Python you choose the environment and the app checks that your script's packages are there before sending. Download results works again for folders: they come over one ssh connection with names made safe for Windows, and a notice tells you when the download has finished. The log window shows the whole log (the last 20 MB of a very big one), opens at the end, has Start, End and Refresh buttons and updates itself every 10 seconds without blocking the app. The short COMSOL test now runs once a month instead of once a week, again only when a job fails because of COMSOL or its license, and Submit and Jobs explain in plain words what it is doing and why. Not code-signed yet.
